An NMOS cascode (gate on ibias) raises the driver output resistance. Gain is gm1*Rout, so Rout sets the -3 dB point via 1/(2*pi*Rout*CL). M1 is sized so Id(VIN_DC)=I, pinning Vout mid-rail. Budget: I=25 uA plus 2*Iref (Iref assumed 4 uA) gives 58 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":       (25e-6, 15e-6, 35e-6),  # branch current (driver = load)
    "L1":      (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # driver length
    "L2":      (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # cascode + reference length
    "L3":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS current-source length (high ro)
    "gmid2":   (8.0, 4.0, 12.0),       # cascode gm/Id
    "gmid_b":  (4.0, 2.5, 8.0),        # reference gm/Id, sets vbn = x + Vgs2 headroom
    "gmid_p":  (5.0, 3.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 4e-6)      # reference current assumed set by testbench
    vin = spec["vin_dc"]
    CL = spec["cl"]

    # Driver: width such that Id(VIN_DC) = I at Vds~0.9 V (fixes Vout_DC near mid-rail)
    unit = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, 0.9)
    W1 = max(0.42, I / unit["Id"])
    d1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, 0.9)

    # Cascode NMOS, PMOS load, and bias references
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I, vds=0.75)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L2"], Iref, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], I, vds=0.9)
    mbp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], Iref, vds=m3.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])   # CS driver
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m2)              # NMOS cascode, gate = vbn
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)               # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("Mref", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)        # diode reference, carries IREF
    n.dev("Mn", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)            # NMOS copy, Iref into vbp
    n.dev("Mbp", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbp)              # PMOS diode, Iref from vdd

    # First-order predictions
    x = mref.vgs - m2.vgs                  # driver drain (cascode source) node
    vmin = x + m2.vdsat                    # lowest saturated output
    vmax = VDD - m3.vdsat                  # highest saturated output
    vdc = 0.5 * (vmin + vmax)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vdc - vmin, vmax - vdc)

    Rcas = (m2.gm / m2.gds) / d1["gds"]    # cascode output resistance
    Rout = 1.0 / (m3.gds + 1.0 / Rcas)
    A = d1["gm"] * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * CL)
    gbw = A * f3db
    power = VDD * (I + 2 * Iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vdc,
        "swing": swing,
    }
